  --question 'How long should the trash keep deleted notes before purging?' \
  --context '85% of restore requests come within 3 weeks of the delete; each month kept costs about $20/month. Purging starts as soon as you pick: everything older than the window is deleted on the first sweep.

**30 days:** about $20/month. Covers the 85% window with a small buffer.
**90 days:** about $60/month. Keeps notes 3x longer than support data needs.' \
  --option '7 days' --option '30 days' --option '90 days' --recommended '30 days' \
  --waiting
